adapter_changes: prepare.py is byte-identical to karpathy/autoresearch at commit 228791fb499afffb54b46200aca536f79142f117 and is immutable. Its evaluator, tokenizer preparation, data loading, and 300-second budget are upstream bytes.

train.py starts from the same upstream commit and differs only by a sealed protocol adapter: read AUTORESEARCH_SEED (default 42), start total timing before the torch import, and print the executed seed in the upstream key:value summary.

The protocol adapter does not change the model, optimizer, hyperparameters, schedules, training loop, dataloader calls, evaluator, or charged training-time calculation. All scientific candidates may modify train.py only.
